codeReview.summary: The implementation fully meets the feature requirements. The Go project structure was initialized correctly with all required directories (cmd/api, internal/handler, internal/service, internal/repository, internal/model). go.mod contains all required dependencies at the correct versions (Gin v1.10.0, pgx v5.7.0, go-redis v9.7.0, client-go v0.32.0). The main.go entry point has a basic Gin router with health/ready endpoints and placeholder API routes, running on port 3100 as specified. The build verification (go mod tidy, go build ./cmd/api, go vet ./...) all passed successfully.
